english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an emotional rather than rational person, mood, work, or response, especially without a strongly negative tone.

examples.english: This film is very sentimental and makes my eyes well up.
examples.traditional: 呢套電影好感性，睇到我眼濕濕。
